description: Korn Ferry Tour leaderboard for the current or most recent tournament (or the event on a given date): tournament name, dates and status, then each player's place, name, country, score to par, round scores and total strokes, from ESPN's public golf scoreboard feed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD to get the event played that week (default: current or most recent)
